name: io.github.jaximus808/tandem-mcp
title: Tandem
description: Local task queue + live board so Claude Code, Cursor and Codex sessions stop double-claiming work

environmentVariables.name: TANDEM_CANVAS_CODE
environmentVariables.description: This project's canvas code (8 characters). Optional: used as the default for canvas_connect.

environmentVariables.name: API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Tandem server URL. Leave unset for the local server, which is started automatically.

environmentVariables.name: TANDEM_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal access token for a self-hosted Tandem with sign-in. Never needed locally.
